{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.16

|gr1= DLC

|descr= Returns an array of the DLC usage times.

|s1= [[getDLCAssetsUsage]]

|r1= [[Array]] - array of DLC usage information, containing DLC items in format:<br>
[<nowiki/>[name, dlcAppId, sessionTime, totalTime], [name, dlcAppId, sessionTime, totalTime], (…)]<br>
'''NOTE:''' unused assets won't appear in the result (usage time = 0).

|x1= <sqf>_dlcAssetsUsageInfo = getDLCAssetsUsage;</sqf>
